# os-deployment — OpenStrata Deployment Template

identity: OpenStrata.NET.Deployment

Short name: os-deployment

Primary output: `Deployment\\OstrataTemplate.1.Deployment.csproj`

Description: Scaffolds a deployment MSBuild project to package and deploy Dataverse artifacts.

Parameters

- `ostrata-version`: (optional) default `1.*`

Usage example

```powershell
dotnet new os-deployment
```
